title: Pegasus Feather
summary: Refine three feathers into the extract for Elixir of Heroism.

fields.Alchemy: Extract 3 Pegasus Feathers into Sublimate of Pegasus Feathers. Combine with any Ash for Elixir of Heroism.
fields.Result: Elixir grants 10 temporary HP and +1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws until Long Rest. Its effect stacks with Bless. A replacement elixir removes the roll bonus and leaves the temporary HP.
fields.Acquisition: Level-dependent merchant stock. Check Blurg and Derryth in the Myconid Colony.
fields.Base value: 9 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
